_doc: Models offered by the front page's selector (pipeline/modelos/portada.py), default first. archivo/draws: paths under web/atlas_electoral/data/, in the format of prediccion.json and prediccion_draws.json. K0 is the published forecast (prediccion.py, updated daily); media and its members are refreshed by portada.py.

modelos.descripcion: Siete modelos de familias distintas (K1, C0, R0, M0, L0, P0 y E0), con el mismo peso cada uno.
